acceptance.claimBoundary: Acceptance ratifies the selected Proofloom product boundary and pilot journey only; it does not authorize implementation, AgentFlow execution, deployment, or production claims.
evidenceRequired: The exact-revision capability inventory and contradictory evidence are presented for review.
The selected journey, requirements, metrics, owner, tests, and review date are recorded in canonical authority.

completionCriteria: An exact-revision capability inventory distinguishes implemented, foundation, proposed, CLI-only, Operator Shell, human-authority, and AgentFlow-owned behavior.
A repository owner accepts or revises the Proofloom product boundary and selects one bounded pilot journey.
The canonical intent authority records the pilot actor, starting state, decisions, success state, recovery state, requirements, metrics, tests, owner, and review date.
The intent index is rebound to the reviewed source hash and reciprocal journey, requirement, and metric validation passes.
Repository-state tests accept a valid staged IN_PROGRESS backlog without weakening the strict all-terminal completion gate.
Changed architecture and design-language authority hashes receive an explicit repository-owner ratification or are revised before the design gate is unlocked.
Every remaining Proofloom task is reviewed against the ratified journey before any task becomes ACTIVE.
The decision preserves AgentFlow as execution authority and introduces no second backlog, component system, design-token system, evidence graph, analytics store, or E2E hierarchy.
nonObjectives: Do not implement runtime or interface changes.
Do not start AgentFlow, dispatch work, or treat a planning artifact as execution approval.
Do not claim one-for-one parity with an earlier application without a source-bound inventory.
objective: Ratify the consolidated Proofloom product boundary and bind it to one canonical, measurable operator journey before implementation.
title: Ratify Proofloom intent and operator journey
